basis: The dashboard shows three monthly bars (January, February, March) with vertical extent encoding alert days. The dashed horizontal line is labeled “Average” and is positioned at the 450 mark on the y-axis. The top of the January bar aligns horizontally with this dashed “Average” line, indicating January’s alert load is at the monthly average. A month at the average maps to the average-range monitoring route.
option_label: Route January to average-range air-quality alert monitoring
